outdoorLightingProcess.heading: Our Outdoor Lighting Installation Process
outdoorLightingProcess.description: Our partners make getting new lights easy and stress-free for you. We follow a simple step-by-step plan to ensure you love the result.

steps.title: Design Consultation
steps.description: We meet with you to walk the property and hear your ideas. Our partners look at the Landfall or Historic District style of your home.

steps.title: Custom Proposal
steps.description: You get a clear plan that shows exactly where lights will go. We explain the costs and the materials we will use upfront.

steps.title: Professional Installation
steps.description: Our expert partners install the wires and fixtures with care for your lawn. We bury lines deep so they don’t get cut by lawnmowers.

steps.title: Nighttime Adjustment
steps.description: We come back after dark to aim every light perfectly. This ensures the shadows and highlights fall exactly where they should.
